title: Switch-SWE: Do Coding Agents Hold Focus When Switching Between Unfinished Tasks?
abstract: arXiv:2611.02017v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software development sessions often involve several unfinished tasks rather than one issue carried through to completion. As coding agents take on repository-level development, they need to recover an earlier task's requirements and partial progress after intervening work. Existing repository-level benchmarks typically score one issue-to-patch episode and do not directly measure whether an agent can resume a task after advancing other unfinished work in the same repository. We introduce \textbf{\ourmethod}, a benchmark for focus-task resumption in sessions that interleave unfinished tasks drawn from the same source repository, with a persistent checkout for each task. Each focus task is evaluated in matched uninterrupted and switched sessions with identical focus requirements and executable verifiers. translated_title: Switch-SWE：编程智能体在未完成任务之间切换时能否保持专注？
translated_abstract: 软件开发会话通常涉及多个未完成的任务，而不是一个问题被一次处理到完成。随着编程智能体承担仓库级别的开发工作，它们需要在中断处理其他工作后，恢复先前任务的需求和部分进展。现有的仓库级基准通常仅对一个“问题到补丁”的会话进行评分，无法直接衡量智能体在同一仓库中推进其他未完成工作之后能否恢复某个任务。我们提出了Switch-SWE，这是一个用于专注任务恢复的基准，其会话中交错进行来自同一源仓库的多个未完成任务，并为每个任务提供持久的代码检出。每个专注任务都在匹配的无中断会话和切换会话中进行评估，两者具有相同的专注任务需求和可执行的验证器。切换会话会交错进行同一仓库中其他未完成任务的有序阶段，而只有最终的专注任务补丁会被评[估]（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了Switch-SWE基准，通过在同一仓库中交错多个未完成任务来评估编程智能体在任务切换后能否保持专注、恢复原任务的需求与进度并成功完成任务。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Switch-SWE, a benchmark that evaluates whether coding agents can maintain focus and successfully resume unfinished tasks after interleaving work on other tasks within the same repository.
